summary.text: Martin Zamora is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico House of Representatives since 2019, representing District 63, which covers Curry, De Baca, Guadalupe, Roosevelt and San Miguel counties.
Zamora is ranking member of the House Agriculture, Acequias and Water Resources Committee and also sits on the House Government, Elections and Indian Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Zamora's occupation as farmer.
Between sessions, Zamora is a member of the Economic and Rural Development and Policy Committee and the Indian Affairs Committee.
